--- title: "Orchids" format: html: toc: true toc-depth: 2 number-sections: true toc-location: left fig-cap-location: top code-fold: false code-tools: true theme: flatly page-layout: full editor: visual --- --- vignette: > %\VignetteIndexEntry{Orchids} %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html} %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8} ---
## Introduction This vignette guides you through downloading, processing, and analyzing **Orchidaceae (Orchids)** occurrence data in Australia. Data is sourced from the [Atlas of Living Australia (ALA)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orchid), enriched with weather station metadata, and visualized in multiple ways. ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## Load Required Packages and Utilities Load all the helper functions using: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} source("vignette-utils.R") ``` ::: You can edit this script at:\ `ecotourism/vignettes/vignette-utils.R` ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## Define Global Parameters ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} organism_name <- "orchids" organism_title <- "Orchids" taxa <- "Orchidaceae" start <- 2014 end <- 2024 email <- "your_email@email.com" ``` ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## Step 1: Download and Prepare Data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} organism <- obs_data(taxa, start, end, your_email=email) |> polished_data() ``` ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} orchids_subset <- read_csv("../data-raw/orchids_subset.csv") organism <- organism %>% mutate( genus = word(scientificName, 1), epithet = word(scientificName, 2), # species-level if it has two words and the 2nd isn't a vague token is_species = !is.na(epithet) & !str_detect(epithet, "^(sp|spp|cf|aff|x|×)\\.?$"), binomial = if_else(is_species, paste(genus, epithet), NA_character_) ) organism <- organism |> filter(is_species==TRUE, scientificName %in% orchids_subset$scientificName, obs_state == "Western Australia") |> select(1:13) ``` ::: ## Step 2: Save Cleaned Dataset ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} mysave(organism_name, organism) ``` ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## Step 3: Attach Nearest Weather Station ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} attach_nearest_station(organism_name) ``` ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## Step 4: Load and Preview Final Dataset ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} load("../data/orchids.rda") glimpse(orchids) ``` ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## Data Analysis ### Preview Dataset ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} organism <- myload(organism_name) organism |> glimpse() ``` ::: ### Occurrence by State ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} organism |> my_count(scientificName, obs_state, f=1) |> as_tibble() ``` ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## Visualization We'll focus on selected species for visualization: ### Spatial Distribution Map ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} organism |> plot_map1() + theme(legend.position = "none") ``` ::: ### Weekly Trends ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} organism |> plot_bar_week() + theme(legend.position = "none") ``` ::: ### Monthly Trends ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} organism |> plot_bar_month() + theme(legend.position = "none") ``` ::: ### Yearly Trends ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} organism |> plot_bar_year() + theme(legend.position = "none") ``` ::: ## Pattern Analysis ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} mss = c() plot_monthly_occurrences_by_state(organism_name, mss) + theme(legend.position = "none") plot_weekly_occurrences_by_state(organism_name, mss) + theme(legend.position = "none") plot_seasonal_occurrence_polar(organism_name, mss) + theme(legend.position = "none") plot_monthly_occurrence_map(organism_name, mss) + theme(legend.position = "none") plot_monthly_occurrence_map_by_state(organism_name, mss) + theme(legend.position = "none") plot_monthly_distribution_map(organism_name, mss) + theme(legend.position = "none") ``` ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## Conclusion You’ve now learned how to: - Access and clean orchid occurrence data from ALA - Add weather station proximity information - Analyze trends for specific genera or species This reproducible workflow can support deeper studies into Orchid ecology and conservation through ecotourism data. ## Final Output This is the glimps of your final data : ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(tidyverse) load("../data/orchids.rda") orchids |> glimpse() ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 34,982 Columns: 14 $ obs_lat -35.20000, -35.20000, -35.20000, -35.20000, -35.20000, … $ obs_lon 117.7000, 117.8000, 117.6000, 116.7000, 118.0000, 117.8… $ date 2017-09-07, 2017-09-11, 2022-08-06, 2016-10-06, 2019-0… $ time "09:30:00", "18:08:00", "09:21:09", "17:32:00", "12:38:… $ year 2017, 2017, 2022, 2016, 2019, 2024, 2024, 2021, 2024, 2… $ month 9, 9, 8, 10, 8, 9, 8, 9, 10, 10, 9, 10, 9, 4, 10, 10, 7… $ day 7, 11, 6, 6, 2, 18, 23, 23, 19, 3, 30, 23, 25, 10, 9, 4… $ hour 9, 18, 9, 17, 12, 10, 9, 16, 11, 14, 13, 12, 12, 16, 16… $ weekday Thursday, Monday, Saturday, Thursday, Friday, Wednesday… $ dayofyear 250, 254, 218, 280, 214, 262, 236, 266, 293, 277, 273, … $ scientificName "Pterostylis heberlei", "Pterostylis heberlei", "Pteros… $ record_type "HUMAN_OBSERVATION", "HUMAN_OBSERVATION", "HUMAN_OBSERV… $ obs_state "Western Australia", "Western Australia", "Western Aust… $ ws_id "948010-99999", "948010-99999", "948010-99999", "956470… ``` ::: :::
